_readme: How the launch is timed. Each rocket has a number of launch moments (times you must press a key at the right time) and a window tightness. window_tightness: 1.0 = normal. A bigger number means a TIGHTER window (harder to hit). A smaller number means a looser window (easier). A cheaper rocket has more moments and tighter windows. Every value has a source: a link, a written game-design choice, or PLACEHOLDER (made up for now; a student replaces it before the final submission). TIMED PRESS (the ring that closes on a target): base_speed 1.0 = the ring takes close_seconds to close; speed 2.0 closes twice as fast. The windows are a share of the ring's trip, so a faster ring gives less time to press. perfect_window and good_window are that share (0.06 = 6% of the trip, before and after the target). Bigger window_tightness makes both windows smaller. The levels do NOT change any of this: timing is the same for every character. LAUNCH: each rocket lists its moment_ids in order. Each moment has a miss_cost: a Miss costs fuel (percent lost) or damages a part (percent damaged). The cost is stored in GameState.damage and never ends the mission. Perfect or Good costs nothing.
